observations_en: The user prompt is identical, but tokenization and layer count differ.
GPT-OSS contains an analysis channel before the final channel; the normalized demo compares final against final.
observations_fr: Le prompt utilisateur est identique, mais la tokenisation et le nombre de couches diffèrent.
GPT-OSS contient un canal analysis avant le canal final ; la démo normalisée compare final contre final.

observations_en: Qwen lexicalizes ‘meta-analysis’ and meta becomes strongly decodable.
GPT-OSS makes meta top-1 in two Logit Lens cells without lexicalizing the word in the visible surface.
observations_fr: Qwen lexicalise « méta-analyse » et meta devient fortement décodable.
GPT-OSS rend meta top-1 dans deux cellules Logit Lens sans lexicaliser le mot dans la surface finale.

scientific_limits: Curated artifacts contain selected positions and layers only.
Cross-model layer numbers are not assumed to represent equivalent computation.
A decodable token candidate is not evidence of consciousness, intention or hidden thought.
Immutable source exports remain the primary evidence and are identified by SHA-256.
